q: Coimbatore's bakeries burn LPG, wood and diesel: what should a bakery record?
title: Coimbatore bakeries: what to record
short: Four things: LPG in kg, oven diesel in litres, wood in tonnes and the monthly power bill. Across Coimbatore's 700 or so bakeries wood is close to half the energy but biogenic; LPG and diesel make up over half of the fossil CO2, roughly 11,300 t a year in all.
audience: Retail and standalone bakeries in Coimbatore district

ul: Over 700 bakeries, about 370 in the city; 95% are micro or small.
Most bake in the back and sell in the front; standalone units supply shops.
Standalone units mostly fire diesel ovens with mono-block burners of 5 to 8 litres an hour; retail bakeries use wood fired brick ovens; a few use electric ovens.
A micro or small bakery uses about 15 toe a year, a medium one about 33.

ol: LPG: kg from each bill, not cylinder count alone.
Diesel: litres bought for the oven, separate from any generator.
Wood: tonnes bought, on a biogenic line of its own.
Electricity: kWh from each month's bill.
Output: you likely count pieces, so weigh a tray of each product once and convert to kg.

ul: Recuperative burners in place of mono-block burners that keep blowing air after the fuel cuts off.
Wood ovens: bake bread at 250 C, then use the falling heat for cakes at 180 C.
Thyristor control on electric ovens: 7 to 15%.
Steel mesh trays in place of heavy mild steel plates, which are about 90% of a trolley's weight: 5 to 10%.
A wood gasifier: up to 50% less wood.

example.title: The average bakery and the cluster (estimate)
lines: Cluster: 7.0 million kWh, 1,140 kL diesel, 1,200 t LPG, 9,000 t wood a year
Per bakery (divided by 700): 10,000 kWh x 0.675 = 6.8 t; 1,629 L diesel x 2.645 = 4.3 t; 1,714 kg LPG x 2.98 = 5.1 t
Fossil total about 16.2 t a year; 12.9 t of wood gives about 22.5 t biogenic CO2, reported separately
example.note: Energy from TERI's cluster profile of Coimbatore bakeries (2015-16). A cluster average; a wood oven shop and a diesel oven plant look very different.

senseible: The calculators take your LPG, diesel and kWh and give the fossil figure; Senseible can read those bills each month so you are not adding them by hand.
